_doc: Designer knobs of the map screen HUD (design/ux/hud.md, Tuning Knobs; only the ones the greybox uses so far). lifespan_warn_share: the share of the lifespan left at or below which the lifespan readout warns (0..1). end_turn_cooldown: seconds after a turn during which End turn is refused. bubbles: the map bubbles (design/ux/hud.md, Map bubbles): trip_seasons = bubble_trip_seasons, how many seasons of travel area bubbles reach; max = bubbles_max, area bubbles on screen at once; region_zoom = how many times the region zoom magnifies the continent view; prefilter_tiles_per_season = a straight-line radius (tiles per season of reach, about the fastest ground speed) inside which route times are worked out; explore_kinds = the place kinds (world_continent.json places[].kind) that get an explore bubble. attitude_bands: [lowest attitude, band word] in rising order (npc-interaction-dialogue.md rule 13: hostile <= -30, cold -29..-10, neutral -9..9, warm 10..29, friendly 30..59, close 60+). link_styles: how tooltipable text looks (design/ux/hud.md Tooltips: Content; LinkStyle): every kind is underlined; colour (#RRGGBB), bold and italic per kind; person colours by relation, item colours by rarity 1-6 (placeholders until the art bible names rarity colours), a sect in its own colour. tooltips: design/ux/hud.md Tooltips and Tuning Knobs: tooltip_delay, tooltip_lock (any of timer, middle, click), tooltip_lock_delay and tooltip_close_grace are the player settings' defaults (seconds); tooltip_depth_max the deepest level; edge_margin the safe zone in layout px; width a tooltip's width in layout px. greybox: settings of the slice-1 greybox only (src/ui/greybox/map_screen.gd), to be replaced by the art bible's look. greybox.seed: the world seed the greybox starts with when no --seed is given. greybox.biome_colours: a flat placeholder colour per biome name of world_continent.json legend.biome_ids (hex RGB). greybox.unknown_colour: the colour of a biome missing from that list. greybox.place_radius_px: the place dot radius in layout pixels at continent zoom. greybox.routes_per_frame: how many of the Places panel's route times are worked out each frame.

paper._doc: Overrides on parchment (windows, tooltips; art bible Section 4: terms cinnabar, relation and rarity colours in their on-parchment values).

greybox._layers_doc: far_layer / near_layer: the painted map layers (art bible Section 1, Principle 2), registered to the 540 x 360 grid (each image covers the whole continent); made by tools/asset-pipeline/map/ (guide.py, paint_tiles.py, prompts/). A missing file falls back to the biome colours.

fight_screen._doc: Fight screen (design/ux/fight-screen.md): timings in ms, sizes in px. Colours from the art bible 7.4/7.5 (hue table; damage types). recent_ms: how long a floating number rises and fades; flash_ms: an art's fire flash; link_ms: a feed's link line; float_group_ms: hits and ticks a side takes within this window share one floating number (one per side per pulse, AC 22). side_colors are on wood (names, header); side_colors_paper on parchment (log lines), art bible Section 4.

status_icons._doc: Engine status id -> icon file under assets/icons/, only where the file is not status/status_<id>.png (all 12 statuses the arts apply match today).

effect_icons._doc: Effect name (combat_effects.json) -> icon file under assets/icons/. Provisional (2026-11-22): only Effects whose subject clearly matches a painted counter or stance icon; the rest show their name until icons are painted.

log._doc: Fight log (Log list pattern): fold_gap_ms: a repeat folds into the entry before it when it comes within this long of its last repeat; fold_kinds: the row kinds that fold; font_px the line size; qi_low_share: the result line names a side short of linh lực when it sat below its cheapest art's cost for at least this share of the fight; colours for the selection, the focus ring, the result line and Full lines.

theme._doc: Rosewood Campaign Table theme (design/art/art-bible.md Section 4, 7.10-7.12, 8.7), built by src/ui/theme/rosewood_theme.gd. palette: Section 4's colours; fonts: res paths and variable-font weights (numbers use tabular figures); sizes: the 7.11 type scale; states: the plaque's colour multiplier for hover, pressed and disabled (one texture, every state drawn by the engine, 7.7).
